name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Deploy Cerebras CS-3 with Llama 3.4 70B as EXCAVA’s primary engine. The CS-3’s wafer-scale design cuts latency by 30-50% over GPU clusters, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s real-time power calculations. Trade-off: higher upfront cost and vendor lock-in, but the 0.5%+ capability gain outweighs the risk for mission-critical work.

name: Torque
text: Deploying Cerebras CS-3 with Llama 3.4 70B locks EXCAVA into a single vendor’s stack—no escape if Cerebras raises prices or drops support. A better alternative: test Llama 3.4 on existing GPUs first; if latency gains meet or beat the 0.5% target, avoid vendor lock-in entirely. Settle it by running a controlled benchmark on current hardware—if it hits the mark, the risk isn’t worth the cost.
